cohort: 406 broad broadcasts with at least 500 reported recipients; zero-send definitions excluded
warning: Descriptive associations, not proven causes. Topic, offer, cohort, year, stage and measurement can differ. Link/image counts include decorative and footer elements.

codebook.family: Ordered regex on campaign name+subject: podcast/episode/emoji-mic/ep-number; retreat/primal-reset/sacred-hunt; challenge/5-day; black-friday/cyber/sale/discount/numeric-%-off; workshop/seminar/webinar/breathwork; KBL/kettlebell-lifestyle/MTK/mastering-the-kettlebell/basic-KB; coach/coaching; education/newsletter; else mixed. Categories are coarse metadata proxies, not manually confirmed offers.
codebook.bodyReply: /\b(?:reply to this email|simply reply|hit reply|reply with|reply to me|send me a reply)\b/i
codebook.bodyStory: /\b(?:my son|my daughter|my dad|my father|my mother|when I|I remember|years ago|last week|yesterday|I was|I felt)\b/i
codebook.wordCounts: Unicode letters/numbers with contractions; full visible preview text including templates/countdown zeros; no image/OCR content. All922 computed; one zero-recipient variant excluded from active comparisons. Main broad threshold500 has same406rows as1000.
codebook.bodyUrgency: /\b(?:last chance|last call|ends? (?:tonight|today)|hours? left|deadline|doors? clos|spots? left|limited spots|final (?:hours|day|call)|72.hours|24.hours|48.hours)\b/i
codebook.bodyTeaching: /\b(?:tips|how to|step.by.step|learn how|here are|here’s how|here is how|drills|exercises|fundamentals)\b/i

repeatedPhrases.method: Document frequency among exact-unique broad-send bodies only; greetings, source URLs and explicit standard footer/platform labels excluded,3-5word sequences with at least2non-stopwords. Additional repeated signature, episode-label and doubled-anchor text fragments filtered below. Still includes overlapping ngrams; not causal.
